title: Database OOM crash, no restart
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the db as the broken part, the memory/OOM problem, and the api 2.3.2 analytics dashboard as the trigger.
root_cause: The new analytics dashboard in api 2.3.2 executed a memory-intensive query that caused the PostgreSQL container to be OOM-killed (signal 9), leaving the database cluster in an inconsistent state with a missing pg_control file that prevents PostgreSQL from starting.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced an analytics dashboard query that makes PostgreSQL exceed its 1 GB memory limit; the database was killed (OOM, signal 9) and the container has no restart policy, so it stays down.
check_first: Inspect the database container's status and logs (e.g., docker ps/docker logs <db_container>)
